definitions.explanation: Short grass grown as ground cover, or a lawn made of such grass. Commonly refers to both the grass itself and the area it covers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}った→張る：12583_haru⟧。
examples.english: We laid turf in the garden.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{裸足|はだし}→裸足：17169_hadashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: The children are running around barefoot on the lawn.

notes:
Refers to lawn grass or turf. The compound ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧ (lawn, grass field) is more common in everyday conversation than {芝|しば} alone. {芝|しば} by itself appears more often in compounds or when talking about the grass material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芝|しば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ — to mow the lawn
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧ — lawn, grass
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧な — keep off the grass
- {人工芝|じんこうしば} — artificial turf
- {天然芝|てんねんしば} — natural turf/grass
- {芝|しば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ — to lay turf

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧ — lawn (the most common everyday form)
- ⟦{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}→芝刈り機：17028_shibakariki⟧ — lawn mower
- ⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧ — play, theater (originally performed on grass-covered areas; now unrelated to grass)

NOTE ON {芝居|しばい}:
The word ⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧ (theater, play) historically derives from {芝|しば} because audiences once sat on the grass to watch performances, but in modern Japanese these words are completely unrelated in meaning.
